displayName: HDR, reflections and VRC Light Volumes
author: Vixen Creations
description: Stops HDR emission being clamped, adds VRC Light Volumes ambient and soft specular, and adds Reflection Strength and Emission Strength controls.
notes: Needs the free VRC Light Volumes package.
Light Volume Intensity 0 falls back to light probes, so the patch is safe in worlds with no volumes.

tokens.name: LIGHT_VOLUMES_INCLUDE
tokens.installHint: Install VRC Light Volumes (red.sim.lightvolumes) from the VRChat Creator Companion or https://github.com/REDSIM/VRCLightVolumes

operations.note: Add the HDR, reflection and Light Volume controls
Point the surface shader at the Light Volume lighting model
Raise the shader target and pull in Light Volumes
Declare the new controls, and stop binding a float property to a bool
Add the Light Volume lighting model
Compare Force Hide as a float
